scripts.check: npm run check:lint && npm run check:fmt
scripts.fix: npm run fix:lint && npm run fix:fmt
scripts.update:deps: npx npm-check-updates --deep -u -x "oxfmt, oxlint, tsdown" && npm install
scripts.update:tools: npx npm-check-updates --deep -u -f "oxfmt, oxlint, tsdown" --dep "prod, dev, optional, peer, packageManager" && npm install
